subject: Nashville SC set MLS record with 77 points and win the Supporters' Shield
title: Nashville's record 77-point season

lines.vo: Seventy-seven points. No MLS side has ever earned more in a season.
They passed Inter Miami's seventy-four from 2024. Three extra points, and the Supporters' Shield.
Nashville joined MLS in twenty-twenty with a tough, low-budget label.
Goalkeeper Brian Schwake and a deep defence did a lot of the work. Not glamorous. Very effective.
Now they are top seed in the East. The playoffs start on the twenty-second against Orlando or Cincinnati.
Low budget, record points. Funny how that works.
Think you can call the MLS Cup winner? Predictions and match news at aboutfootball dot UK.
